title: Placebo Neuroepo multisession Phase II and III
description: Multisession EEG dataset from a randomized, placebo-controlled study of intranasal NeuroEPO (erythropoietin-derived formulation) in patients with Parkinson's disease. Clinical (MDS-UPDRS III) and EEG assessments were acquired at baseline and 9 months after completing the intervention. Cumulative NeuroEPO dose is coded per participant (placebo = 0), enabling analysis of treatment effects on brain activity.
methods_description: Participants were randomized to NeuroEPO or placebo. Clinical and EEG assessments were conducted pre-intervention and 9 months after the intervention period. Motor severity was rated by two certified neurologists using MDS-UPDRS III. Cumulative dose was quantified as total NeuroEPO dose, with placebo coded as 0.
